NAME: SLA_MONITORED_HOSTS
SQLQUERY: select count(*) from mss.host where host.service_company_id != 6 and host.active = 1 and exists (select host_id from mss.host2service where host_id=host.id)
DESCRIPTION: Daily count of active customer hosts attached to a service (excluding OS hosts, 2 year history)

NAME: SLA_MONITORING_OK
SQLQUERY: select (case when exists (select mmsc.* from mc.mon_server_connection mmsc, mss.host mh, mss.host2service mh2s, mss.service ms where mmsc.host_id = mmsc.mon_server_id and mmsc.host_id = mh.id and mh.id = mh2s.host_id and mh2s.service_id = ms.id and ms.service_type_id = 121 and cast(entry_date as date) > sysdate - 2/(24*60)) then 1 else 0 end) monitoring_ok from dual
DESCRIPTION: Minutely availability of connection monitoring servers (2 year history): 1=1 or more available, 0=none available

NAME: COUNTRY_NEWEST_HOST
SQLQUERY: SELECT cr.name FROM mss.host h, mss.address a, mss.city c, mss.country cr WHERE a.id = h.address_id AND c.id   = a.city_id AND cr.id  = c.country_id AND h.id =(SELECT MAX(h2s.host_id) FROM mss.host2service h2s, mss.service_feature sf WHERE h2s.service_id   = sf.service_id AND sf.operational_date = (SELECT MAX(a_date) FROM (SELECT MIN(operational_date) as a_date FROM MSS.SERVICE_FEATURE GROUP BY SERVICE_ID)));
DESCRIPTION: Country of the most recently configured host

NAME: NEWEST_COUNTRY
SQLQUERY: SELECT newest_country FROM (SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY MIN(sf.operational_date) DESC, cr.name) r, cr.name newest_country, MIN(sf.operational_date) newest_date FROM mss.host h, mss.country cr, mss.address a, mss.city ct, mss.service_feature sf, mss.host2service h2s WHERE h.id = h2s.host_id AND h2s.service_id = sf.service_id AND cr.id = ct.country_id AND a.id = h.address_id AND a.city_id = ct.id AND sf.operational_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cr.name) WHERE r = 1;
DESCRIPTION: The newest country under the Mission Control Sun

NAME: LAST_RATED_TICKET
SQLQUERY: select max(e.ticket_id) from tt.event e, tt.ticket_rating r where r.event_id = e.id and e.eventdate = (select max(e2.eventdate) from tt.event e2, tt.ticket_rating r2 where e2.id = r2.event_id)
DESCRIPTION: ID of the ticket with the most recent rating

NAME: AVG_RATING_LAST_30_DAYS
SQLQUERY: select round(avg(rating),2) from tt.ticket_rating r, tt.event e where e.id = r.event_id and e.eventdate > sysdate - 30
DESCRIPTION: The average of all ratings within the last 30 days

NAME: MC_LOAD_LEVEL
SQLQUERY: SELECT CASE WHEN count(1) < 20 THEN 'LOW' WHEN count(1) < 31 THEN 'MED' ELSE 'HIGH' END CASE FROM tt.ticket WHERE status_id in (1,2,3,4) AND type_id NOT IN (4,5) AND handled_by_mcc=1
DESCRIPTION: The MC load expressed in terms of LOW, MED, HIGH

NAME: NUMBER_OF_CHANGES_LAST_30
SQLQUERY: SELECT COUNT(*) from tt.ticket where open_date > SYSDATE - 30 AND type_id IN (2, 3, 8, 12, 13, 14)
DESCRIPTION: Number of change tickets opened in the last 30 days

NAME: NUMBER_OF_INCIDENTS_LAST_30
SQLQUERY: SELECT COUNT(*) from tt.ticket where open_date > SYSDATE - 30 AND type_id IN (1, 11, 6)
DESCRIPTION: Number of incidents tickets opened in the last 30 days

NAME: NUMBER_OF_ISP_OUTAGES_LAST_30
SQLQUERY: SELECT COUNT(*) from tt.ticket where open_date > SYSDATE - 30 AND type_id = 4
DESCRIPTION: Number of isp outage tickets opened in the last 30 days

NAME: ENGINEER_ACTIONS_LAST_24H
SQLQUERY: select count(*) from tt.event e, tt.event_type et WHERE e.type_id = et.id AND et.source in (5,4) and e.eventdate > SYSDATE - 1 and e.public_event = 1
DESCRIPTION: Number of MC engineer actions in MC ticketing in the last 24h

NAME: CUSTOMER_ACTIONS_LAST_24H
SQLQUERY: select count(*) from tt.event e, tt.event_type et WHERE e.type_id = et.id AND et.source = 3 and e.eventdate > SYSDATE - 1
DESCRIPTION: Number of customer actions in MC ticketing in the last 24h

NAME: INCIDENT_REACTION_TIME_AVG_24H
SQLQUERY: select round(avg((ack - esc) * 24 * 60 * 60)) FROM (SELECT e.ticket_id tid, e.type_id, e.eventdate ESC, LEAD(e.eventdate, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY e.ticket_id ORDER BY e.ticket_id DESC, e.eventdate) AS ACK FROM tt.event e, tt.ticket t WHERE t.id = e.ticket_id AND t.status_id not in (110, 120) AND e.type_id in (60001, 60002) and e.eventdate > sysdate - 1 order by e.ticket_id desc, e.eventdate) WHERE type_id = 60001 and ACK is not null
DESCRIPTION: Average incident reaction time of MC during the last 24h

NAME: TICKETS_IN_PROGRESS_AVG_1H
SQLQUERY: select avg(value) from report.channelvalue where channelkey_id=16 and TIMESTAMP > SYSTIMESTAMP - 1/24
DESCRIPTION: Average number of tickets in progress during the last hour.
